question: The Tri-Color which was hoisted in Stuttgart by Madam Cama was smuggled into British India by: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: Veer Savarkar
Kishan Singh
Indulal Yagnik
Bhikaji Cama
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Indulal Yagnik

Explanation:
Madam Bhikaji Cama hoisted the first Indian tricolor at the International Socialist Conference in Stuttgart, Germany in 1907. This flag was smuggled into British India by Indulal Yagnik, a prominent freedom fighter and socialist leader. He safely brought the flag to India, where it later became a symbol of revolutionary activities. The flag had green, yellow, and red stripes with 'Vande Mataram' inscribed in the center.

question_hi: मैडम कामा द्वारा स्टटगार्ट में फहराया गया तिरंगा ब्रिटिश भारत में किसके द्वारा तस्करी कर लाया गया था? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options_hi: वीर सावरकर

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है इंदुलाल याज्ञनिक

Explanation:
मैडम भीकाजी कामा ने 1907 में जर्मनी के स्टटगार्ट शहर में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समाजवादी सम्मेलन में भारत का पहला तिरंगा फहराया था। इस झंडे को ब्रिटिश भारत में तस्करी कर लाने का काम इंदुलाल याज्ञनिक ने किया था। वे एक प्रसिद्ध स्वतंत्रता सेनानी और समाजवादी नेता थे। उन्होंने इस झंडे को सुरक्षित रूप से भारत पहुँचाया और यह बाद में क्रांतिकारी गतिविधियों का प्रतीक बना।

question: Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place during the term of Viceroy ___________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: Lord Irwin
Lord Dalhousie
Lord Chelmsford
Lord Ripon
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lord Chelmsford

Explanation:
The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar. It took place during the tenure of Lord Chelmsford as Viceroy of India (1916-1921). Lord Chelmsford had enforced the Rowlatt Act in 1919, against which people had gathered at Jallianwala Bagh. General Dyer ordered the troops to open fire on the unarmed crowd, resulting in hundreds of deaths. A Hunter Commission was appointed to inquire into the incident.

☛ Officer who ordered firing → General Dyer

☛ Name of the inquiry commission → Hunter Commission
question_hi: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड किस वायसराय के कार्यकाल में हुआ था? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)

question: The first attempt to calculate national income in India was made by: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: Dadabhai Naoroji
VKRV Rao
PC Mahalanobis
SD Tendulkar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dadabhai Naoroji

Explanation:
The first attempt to calculate national income in India was made by Dadabhai Naoroji in 1876 in his book 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'. He estimated India's national income for the year 1867-68. Subsequently, VKRV Rao estimated national income for 1925-29. The first scientific calculation was done by the National Income Committee under the chairmanship of PC Mahalanobis in 1949. SD Tendulkar is known for his work on poverty line estimation. Dadabhai Naoroji's estimate was based on agriculture, industry, and services sectors.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which committee gave the first scientific estimate of national income? → National Income Committee headed by PC Mahalanobis (1949)
☛ For which year did VKRV Rao estimate national income? → 1925-29
☛ For which year did Dadabhai Naoroji estimate national income? → 1867-68
☛ When did official national income calculation start in India? → 1955 by Central Statistical Office
☛ What is SD Tendulkar's major contribution? → Measurement of poverty line
question_hi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना करने का पहला प्रयास किसके द्वारा किया गया था? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options_hi: दादा भाई नौरोजी
वीकेआरवी राव
पीसी महलानोबिस
एसडी तेंदुलकर
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है दादा भाई नौरोजी

Explanation:
भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना का पहला प्रयास दादा भाई नौरोजी ने 1876 में अपनी पुस्तक 'पॉवर्टी एंड अन-ब्रिटिश रूल इन इंडिया' में किया था। उन्होंने 1867-68 के लिए भारत की राष्ट्रीय आय का अनुमान लगाया। इसके बाद वीकेआरवी राव ने 1925-29 के लिए राष्ट्रीय आय का अनुमान प्रस्तुत किया। वैज्ञानिक ढंग से पहली बार राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना पीसी महालनोबिस के नेतृत्व में 1949 में गठित राष्ट्रीय आय समिति ने की। एसडी तेंदुलकर ने गरीबी रेखा के अनुमान के लिए जाना जाता है। दादा भाई नौरोजी ने कृषि, उद्योग और सेवाओं पर आधारित प्रारंभिक अनुमान दिया।

question: The law that permitted widows to remarry (Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act) was passed in the year: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1858
1855
1856
1854
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1856

Explanation:
The Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act was passed in 1856. It was the first law in India to legalize the remarriage of widows. This act was enacted under the tenure of Lord Dalhousie and was strongly advocated by social reformer Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar. The law gave legal recognition to widow remarriage and removed traditional restrictions. It remained in force until 1956, when it was replaced by the Hindu Marriage Act of 1955. This legislation played a crucial role in social reform and women's rights in India.

☛ Who was the Governor-General when the act was passed? → Lord Dalhousie
☛ How long did this act remain in force? → Until 1956
☛ Which law replaced this act? → Hindu Marriage Act of 1955

question: Eminent Social reformer and Women’s education activist Pandita Ramabai Sarasvati was a great scholar of ______ (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: English
Marathi
Sanskrit
Hindi
solution:

Explanation:
Pandita Ramabai Sarasvati (1858-1922) was a prominent social reformer, women's education activist, and great scholar. She was highly proficient in Sanskrit and is considered a great scholar of this language. She pursued higher studies in Sanskrit at the University of Calcutta and earned the title 'Pandita'. Ramabai established several institutions for women's education and upliftment, including 'Sharada Sadan' and 'Mukti Mission'. She actively campaigned against social evils like widowhood and child marriage. Her command over Sanskrit made her a key figure in the Indian Renaissance.

question_hi: प्रख्यात समाज सुधारक और महिला शिक्षा कार्यकर्ता पंडिता रमाबाई सरस्वती ______ की महान विदुषी थीं। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: Where was the first British presidency established in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Surat
Kolkata
Mumbai
Goa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Surat

Explanation:
The first British presidency in India was established at Surat in 1612, when the East India Company obtained trading privileges from Mughal Emperor Jahangir. Subsequently, presidencies were set up in Mumbai (1687) and Kolkata (1690). The Surat presidency laid the foundation for British colonization and remained the center of British activities until 1636. Goa was under Portuguese control, not British.

question: Who founded the Muhammdan Anglo-Oriental college in 1875 which later became Aligarh Muslim University?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Zakir Hussain

Mohammad Ali Jinna

He believed that education was the key to the community's progress and encouraged Muslims to adopt English studies. He also started the Aligarh Movement to promote educational and social reforms. Syed Ahmed Khan was born in 1817 in Delhi and was knighted by the British government as a recognition of his services. His efforts laid the foundation for modern Muslim education in India.

question: Who was the first Muslim President of the Indian National Congress? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/01/2021) Shift 1)

question: How many demands did Mahatma Gandhi make in his letter to Lord Irwin some of which were agreed to and came to be known as Gandhi-lrwin Pact? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 10
13
12
11
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 11

Explanation:
Mahatma Gandhi made a total of 11 demands in his letter to Lord Irwin dated March 2, 1930. These demands primarily included the abolition of salt tax, reduction of land revenue, prohibition of liquor, and release of political prisoners. Later, under the Gandhi-Irwin Pact (March 5, 1931), only some demands were agreed upon, such as the withdrawal of the Civil Disobedience Movement, permission to make salt, and release of political prisoners. This pact paved the way for Gandhi's participation in the Second Round Table Conference.

question: The Rowlatt Act was passed in ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1920
1919
1921
1922
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1919

Explanation:
The Rowlatt Act was passed in 1919 by the British Indian government. This act gave the British government the power to arrest and detain any person without trial. It was introduced under the pretext of suppressing anarchy and revolutionary crimes. In protest, Mahatma Gandhi launched the Rowlatt Satyagraha in 1919. In response, the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on April 13, 1919. The Rowlatt Act was a significant event in the Indian independence movement.

question: Which famous revolutionary set up base near Satar river in Jhansi in the 1920’s using the alias, Pandit Harishankar Brahmachari? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Bhagat singh
Udham singh
Khudiram Bose
Chandrashekhar Azad
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chandrashekhar Azad

Explanation:
Chandrashekhar Azad was a prominent revolutionary in the Indian independence movement. In the 1920s, to avoid arrest, he lived near the Satar river in Jhansi under the alias Pandit Harishankar Brahmachari and established a base there. He secretly carried out revolutionary activities. Azad was an active member of the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) and later the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA). He was involved in events like the Kakori Conspiracy, the Lahore Conspiracy Case, and the 1929 bombing of the Central Legislative Assembly. Born in 1906, he was martyred in 1931 at Alfred Park, Allahabad, in a police encounter. His real name was Chandrashekhar Tiwari, and he had taken a vow to never be captured alive by the British, adopting the surname 'Azad' meaning free.

Explanation:
1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधार (भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1909) ने मुसलमानों के लिए पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल की व्यवस्था शुरू की। इससे हिंदू और मुसलमानों के बीच राजनीतिक दूरी बढ़ी और सांप्रदायिकता को बढ़ावा मिला। यह सुधार लॉर्ड मिंटो (वायसराय) और जॉन मॉर्ले (भारत सचिव) के नाम पर है। इसने मुसलमानों को अलग से वोट देने और अपने प्रतिनिधि चुनने का अधिकार दिया। बाद में 1935 के भारत सरकार अधिनियम में भी इसी सिद्धांत का विस्तार किया गया।
